title: A cartesian square induces an isomorphism on the kernels of its horizontal maps
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that in a commutative square in an abelian category, cartesianness makes the induced map between the kernels of the two horizontal maps an isomorphism, and dually for cokernels and cocartesian squares (statement lines 1068-1086). The proof is a complete argument for the first assertion: cartesianness provides a morphism into the upper left object which factors through the kernel of the upper horizontal map (proof lines 1088-1093), and two displayed computations in which the kernel injections are cancelled give the two inverse relations (proof lines 1094-1100); the second assertion follows by duality. The non-formal content is the construction of the morphism from the kernel and the two cancellations. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
